note: Every one of its six sentences renders усмехнуться as 'smirked/smirk' — the flag on «Она́ ехи́дно усмехну́лась» is about the sentence wording ('grinned'), not a sense the gloss 'to smirk (to grin)' fails to reach.
All six sentences ('Mum calmed the crying child', 'I will calm her with one call') use exactly the standard gloss 'to calm', and 'to soothe' is already in the note, so no sense is missing.

alt: to suit (to be acceptable to someone)
note: «Меня́ устра́ивает э́та цена́» ('This price suits me') and «Меня́ устра́ивала бы цена́ пони́же» need the 'be acceptable to' sense, which appears only inside the unaccepted parenthetical note and so is not a graded answer.

alt: to suit (to be acceptable to someone)
note: «Тако́е реше́ние устро́ит всех» ('Such a decision will suit everyone') uses the 'be acceptable to' sense, which the graded short gloss 'to arrange' does not cover at all.

alt: to be enough (impersonal, of something in short supply)
note: Three of the five sentences — «Мне не хвата́ет вре́мени» ('I don't have enough time'), «Без де́нег нам не бу́дет хвата́ть на еду́» and «Мне бы хвата́ло вре́мени без спе́шки» — use the impersonal 'suffice' sense, unreachable from the graded gloss 'to grab'.
All six sentences render хохотать as 'laugh loudly' ('The children are laughing loudly at the clown'), and 'to guffaw' is already noted, so nothing is missing.
Every sentence is literal sewing ('Grandma used to sew dresses to order'); the flag concerns the noun костю́м in «Она́ бу́дет шить костю́м всю неде́лю», not the gloss of шить.
All six sentences, including «Мо́ре шуме́ло всю ночь» ('The sea was making noise all night'), use the standard gloss; 'roaring' would be a stylistic variant of the same sense, not a new one.
Every sentence is the copular sense already given by the standard gloss ('He is the director of the firm', 'These books are rare'); no sentence needs 'to appear' or 'to represent'.
